identity_warnings: Bennett Brant is reported shot in early Amazing Spider-Man, yet the later Crime-Master reveal identifies him as Bennett. Treat as a continuity reconciliation requiring panel-level confirmation, not two separate people without evidence.
Ned Leeds acts as a brainwashed Hobgoblin proxy; do not conflate him with Roderick Kingsley or Jason Macendale.
Phil Urich is not Ben Urich and is not the same Green Goblin as Norman Osborn or Harry Osborn.
Marvel explicitly marks its Phil Urich character page as crowd-sourced and unverified.
The reported late-1980s death of Ned Leeds should not be asserted as a permanent current status without checking later retcons and clone/revival plots.
Issue chronology for the mid-2000s Night Nurse clinic exposure and the Brother Power/Sister Sun story is era-scoped pending panel-level verification.
All sources are publisher-hosted; biographies remain secondary summaries rather than original-panel evidence.
